name: Akron Dreams 2026
administrator: East Akron Neighborhood Development Corporation (EANDC), in partnership with the City of Akron
summary_plain_english: Akron Dreams is a City of Akron first-time homebuyer program that can provide a forgivable $7,500 loan toward down payment and closing costs for an eligible owner-occupant purchasing inside Akron city limits.

benefit.summary: Forgivable down-payment/closing-cost assistance of $7,500, subject to program funding and final administrator approval.

criteria.first_time_definition: Buyer must not have been a property owner in the prior three years.
criteria.homebuyer_education_required: Minimum 8 hours with a HUD-approved counseling agency; EANDC program page states certification within the last two years.
criteria.income_limit_basis: 80% HUD Area Median Income as published for Akron Dreams 2026
criteria.property_value_rule: Property value cannot exceed 95% of Akron's median purchase price for single-family housing; the current dollar threshold requires administrator/source confirmation before deterministic evaluation.

tradeoffs: The property is deed-restricted for five years and the assistance is secured by a second-mortgage lien.
The buyer must contribute at least 1% of the purchase price.
Liquid assets above $15,000 must first be applied to the purchase under the published criteria.
Funding is first-come, first-served, so matching the eligibility rules does not guarantee money will still be available.
The buyer should compare this assistance with alternative financing based on cash required, monthly payment, rate, lien/forgiveness terms, and total borrowing cost.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: The published program requires the property to be inside the City of Akron.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: We need the target municipality or property address to confirm Akron city limits.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: Akron Dreams requires the buyer not to have been a property owner during the prior three years.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: We need to know whether any applicable buyer owned property during the prior three years.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: The home must be owner occupied.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: We need to know whether the home will be your primary residence.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: The published criteria list a minimum credit score of 620.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: An approximate credit-score band is needed to screen the published 620 minimum.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: Known household income appears above the published Akron Dreams 2026 limit for that household size.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: Household size and approximate gross household income are needed to screen the published income limit.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: Written mortgage preapproval is required, but this can potentially be completed before applying.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: We need to know whether written mortgage preapproval has been obtained.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: The published criteria require preapproval for a fixed-rate 30-year mortgage.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: The planned mortgage term/rate structure is needed to screen this requirement.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: Required homebuyer education is not yet complete, but it may be possible to complete it before program approval.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: We need to know whether the required HUD-approved homebuyer education has been completed.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: The published criteria state no bankruptcy or foreclosure during the prior two years.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: This program specifically requires confirmation about bankruptcy or foreclosure during the prior two years.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: Published criteria cap retained liquid assets at $15,000 and require excess funds to be applied to the purchase; this needs administrator review rather than an automatic rejection.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: Approximate liquid assets are relevant to this program's published $15,000 retained-asset rule.

rules.buyer_reason_fail: Published criteria allow a one- or two-unit property.
rules.buyer_reason_missing: We need the property's number of dwelling units.
Funding is first-come, first-served and must be confirmed with EANDC.
The published criteria use a current Akron median-price-based property value limit; HBE should confirm the current dollar threshold with the administrator before relying on it.

authoritative_sources.publisher: East Akron Neighborhood Development Corporation / City of Akron
authoritative_sources.document_title: Akron Dreams First Time Homebuyer Down Payment Assistance Program 2026 — Eligibility Criteria
authoritative_sources.version_note: Criteria copy linked from/associated with the current program; HBE should preserve the administrator-hosted source URL when available.

human_caveats: Program launched in August 2026 and funds are first-come, first-served; availability requires frequent verification.
The published property-value rule references 95% of Akron's median purchase price rather than giving a durable threshold in the criteria copy reviewed; do not hard-code an inferred dollar limit.
The liquid-asset rule is not modeled as an automatic exclusion when assets exceed $15,000 because the published language says excess funds must first be applied to the purchase.
Final eligibility is determined by the program administrator/lender, not HBE.
